notes.title: I found myself in a strange house and I'm scared - is out!
notes.content:
I found myself in a strange house and I'm scared - is out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379590/I_found_myself_in_a_strange_house_and_Im_scared/

I found myself in a strange house and I'm scared. I think I got into some kind of loop. The house is constantly changing, surely I saw something inexplicable and terrible. I have to get out of here. Every time I go through a cycle, one of the chains on the basement door disappears. I should probably get in there and get out of here. I'm very scared.


 Explore the strange house.
 If you find an anomaly, turn back immediately.
 If you don't find any anomalies, do not turn back.
 There are no anomalies on the first level.
 Try to get out of here.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/25807341/f0cff6e81943cca52c7f4d355ed11bfefac677d1.png

 Anomaly search game
 Huge number of anomalies
 Several endings
 Creepy atmosphere
 Psychological horror
 Achievements


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/25807341/1ef41db17a27516035b42074b895900f6af89838.png

notes.title: Cube0S is out!
notes.content:
A turn-based puzzle is available! I wish all fans of the genre a good game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2583460/CubeOS/

CubeOS is a logic turn-based puzzle game, you play as a High-Tech Cube, the goal of whom is to complete the level at all costs. The motivation for the hero will be added later! (UPD: Motivation has been added!)

Over 90 levels
A variety of enemies
10 types of interactive items
Challenges along the way
Portals
Simple levels
Terribly difficult levels
Plot
Cute Sci-fi style
Steam Achievements
Steam Cloud
